title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: fire services
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Sprinkler and hydrant pipework at height
swms.task: Install sprinkler and hydrant pipework in the apartment ceilings, corridors and risers, from scissor lifts more than 2 m above the floor, drilling into the post-tensioned slabs for hanger anchors, and roll grooving and cutting pipe on each floor.

facts.fallControl: Risers are screened at each level with only the section being worked on opened, and scissor lifts with guardrails are used for all work above 2 m.
facts.silicaControls: Hanger anchor holes are drilled with on-tool dust extraction. Fit tested P2 respirators are worn while drilling. The written silica assessment is done before work starts and attached to this SWMS.

steps: Install sprinkler and hydrant pipework at height
Roll groove, thread and cut pipe

swms.title: Fire pump room, testing and live connections
swms.task: Pressure test the sprinkler and hydrant pipework with water, connect new pipework to the live fire system and commission the fire pumps in the pump room.

facts.pressureTesting: Tested with water to 1,500 kPa, with the area barricaded and signed during the test, and pressure released through the drain valve before any fitting is touched.
facts.isolationProcedure: Fire pumps are isolated at their controllers and locked out with personal padlocks, valves are locked closed and tagged, and pressure is released before breaking into pipework.

steps: Work on live fire systems and in pump rooms

rules.phrase: a tag alone is not an isolation
rules.source: Model Code: Managing the risks of plant in the workplace s 4.5
rules.quote: A tag should not be used on its own as an isolation device

rules.phrase: the machine cannot restart until a removed guard is replaced
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 208, s 210
rules.quote: the plant cannot be restarted unless the guarding is replaced

rules.phrase: secured at or near the top or bottom
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 306L, s 306M
rules.quote: the ladder is secured (i) at or near the top to prevent it moving; or ... (ii) at or near the bottom to prevent it moving
